# theScore

> theScore is a digital sports media platform by Penn Entertainment delivering real-time scores, news, stats, and analysis across major professional and college sports leagues.

theScore publishes original sports journalism including breaking news, game recaps, previews, and analysis articles. Content is organized by league, with each league having its own landing page, news feed, and live scores.

## Major Leagues

- [NFL](https://www.thescore.com/nfl): National Football League news, scores, and standings
- [NBA](https://www.thescore.com/nba): National Basketball Association news, scores, and standings
- [NHL](https://www.thescore.com/nhl): National Hockey League news, scores, and standings
- [MLB](https://www.thescore.com/mlb): Major League Baseball news, scores, and standings
- [EPL](https://www.thescore.com/epl): English Premier League news, scores, and standings

## College Sports

- [NCAAF](https://www.thescore.com/ncaaf): NCAA Football news, scores, and standings
- [NCAAB](https://www.thescore.com/ncaab): NCAA Basketball news, scores, and standings
- [WCBK](https://www.thescore.com/wcbk): Women's College Basketball news, scores, and standings

## Other Leagues

- [CFL](https://www.thescore.com/cfl): Canadian Football League
- [MLS](https://www.thescore.com/mls): Major League Soccer
- [MMA](https://www.thescore.com/mma): Mixed Martial Arts
- [WNBA](https://www.thescore.com/wnba): Women's National Basketball Association
- [Formula 1](https://www.thescore.com/formula1): Formula 1 Racing
- [NASCAR](https://www.thescore.com/nascar): NASCAR Racing
- [PGA](https://www.thescore.com/pga): PGA Tour Golf
- [ATP](https://www.thescore.com/atp): Men's Tennis
- [WTA](https://www.thescore.com/wta): Women's Tennis

## European Football

- [Champions League](https://www.thescore.com/chlg): UEFA Champions League
- [La Liga](https://www.thescore.com/liga): Spanish La Liga
- [Serie A](https://www.thescore.com/seri): Italian Serie A
- [Bundesliga](https://www.thescore.com/bund): German Bundesliga
- [Ligue 1](https://www.thescore.com/fran): French Ligue 1
- [UEFA](https://www.thescore.com/uefa): UEFA competitions

## Content Structure

- League landing pages: `/{league}` — latest news and scores
- News feeds: `/{league}/news` — articles for a specific league
- Live scores: `/{league}/events` — live and recent game scores
- Team pages: `/{league}/teams/{teamId}` — roster, schedule, stats
- Articles: `/{league}/news/{articleId}/{title}` — individual news articles
- Authors: `/author/{authorSlug}` — journalist profile pages

## Optional

- [LPGA](https://www.thescore.com/lpga): LPGA Tour Golf
- [Authors Index](https://www.thescore.com/authors): Full list of theScore journalists
- [Top News](https://www.thescore.com/news): Cross-league top news
